import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    bg=g[0][0]; out=[row[:] for row in g]; H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    # find maximal rectangles per color
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            # height
            h=0
            while i+h<H and g[i+h][j]==c: h+=1
            w=0
            while j+w<W and all(g[i][j+k]==c for k in range(w+1)): w+=1
            # shrink to max rectangle
            while True:
                ok=all(g[r][k]==c for r in range(i,i+h) for k in range(j,j+w) if seen[r][k]==False)
                if ok: break
                if h>=2: h-=1
                elif w>=2: w-=1
                else: break
            for r in range(i,i+h):
                for k in range(j,j+w):
                    seen[r][k]=True
                    if (r==i or r==i+h-1) and (k==j or k==j+w-1):
                        out[r][k]= 1 if (r in (i,i+h-1) and k in (j,j+w-1)) else 4
                    else:
                        out[r][k]= 2 if 0<h-2 and 0<w-2 else (4 if (r in (i,i+h-1) or k in (j,j+w-1)) else 0)
    return out

# verify on demo
d=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(f(d)==o)
res=f(G['Test input'])
for r in res: print(' '.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(res))
